mapping_method: Preserve all154 previous mappings except explicit genuine Q18 survival additions; append all9 surviving real-core questions before any expanded answers. Separate unasked key background. Reachability credit remains separate from grading requirements.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

creator_provenance.role: Pre-test consolidation of both independently accepted map16 context corrections

questions.question: A single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power resolves, then some Dahan leave. Compare that with Dahan on their Guard and with Encompassing Ward when Presence moves.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power resolves, then some Dahan leave. Compare that with Dahan on their Guard and with Encompassing Ward when Presence moves.
required_facts: An ordinary single-land Defend-per-Dahan Power fixes its value when used; later Dahan departure does not lower it.
Dahan on their Guard checks current Dahan when the ongoing Defend matters.
Encompassing Ward follows the target Spirit's current Presence, gaining/losing lands as it moves.

questions.question: When Crops Wither and Fade offers an or choice, is its 2 Fear optional? If Veil the Night’s Hunt has three Dahan but two Invaders, can the third point be added to an already-hit Invader?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When Crops Wither and Fade offers an or choice, is its 2 Fear optional? If Veil the Night’s Hunt has three Dahan but two Invaders, can the third point be added to an already-hit Invader?
required_facts: Crops always gives 2 Fear; its or separates only replacement alternatives.
Veil must give each of the two Invaders 1 Damage and waste the third point.
It cannot add the third point to an already-hit Invader.

questions.question: What is Song of Sanctity’s speed if its cost-circle color is missing? What does the missing symbol on Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship’s third line require, and is its Invader-on-Invader Damage simultaneous?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What is Song of Sanctity’s speed if its cost-circle color is missing? What does the missing symbol on Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship’s third line require, and is its Invader-on-Invader Damage simultaneous?
required_facts: Song of Sanctity is Slow regardless of a missing cost-ring color.
Dissolve's missing third-line symbol is Explorer: Push all Explorers from target land.
Its Invader-on-Invader Damage is simultaneous, so they can destroy each other.

questions.question: Does Poisoned Land’s threshold count Blight that the Power itself just added? How is Tsunami’s extra Fear applied, and does an unqualified +4 Damage threshold add 4 to every piece hit earlier?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does Poisoned Land’s threshold count Blight that the Power itself just added? How is Tsunami’s extra Fear applied, and does an unqualified +4 Damage threshold add 4 to every piece hit earlier?
required_facts: Poisoned Land counts the Blight it added earlier in that use.
Tsunami's threshold generates extra Fear for each other affected Coastal land.
An unqualified +4 Damage threshold supplies four total Damage at that point, not four more to every previously hit piece.

questions.question: Can Wrap in Wings of Sunlight grant Defend if it moves zero Dahan? Can it count as movement when Dahan are moved to their current land if otherwise permitted? Can Blazing Renewal do threshold Damage with no destroyed Presence to add?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Can Wrap in Wings of Sunlight grant Defend if it moves zero Dahan? Can it count as movement when Dahan are moved to their current land if otherwise permitted? Can Blazing Renewal do threshold Damage with no destroyed Presence to add?
required_facts: Wrap moving zero Dahan supplies no moved-to land and gives no Defend.
An otherwise unrestricted same-land Move counts as movement.
Blazing Renewal with no restored destroyed Presence cannot do threshold Damage because there is no placement land.

questions.question: The Trees and Stones Speak of War is used with five Dahan and its threshold Pushes two to different adjacent lands. How much Defend stays and reaches each destination? Does a later unrelated Dahan move carry it further?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The Trees and Stones Speak of War is used with five Dahan and its threshold Pushes two to different adjacent lands. How much Defend stays and reaches each destination? Does a later unrelated Dahan move carry it further?
required_facts: After the threshold Pushes two to different lands, Defend 6 remains and each destination gets Defend 2.
Later unrelated movement does not carry it again.

key_context_not_required.fact: Additional Defend boosts in original land stay there.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The stated case has no additional Defend boost, and the question only asks the specified five-Dahan distribution and later movement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Destination Dahan already present do not multiply the transported Defend.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt gives no preexisting Dahan in either destination; only the stated five-Dahan Defend distribution and later unrelated movement are requested.

questions.question: Does Infinite Vitality’s threshold save Dahan from Remove or Replace? Does its Blight protection prohibit choosing the land as a cascade destination?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Does Infinite Vitality’s threshold save Dahan from Remove or Replace? Does its Blight protection prohibit choosing the land as a cascade destination?
required_facts: Infinite Vitality's threshold does not prevent Remove/Replace of Dahan.
Its Blight prevention does not forbid choosing that land for a cascade; the choice remains legal and the effect changes what happens there.

key_context_not_required.fact: Infinite Vitality's threshold protects Dahan from Damage/Destroy.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The literal threshold question asks about Remove and Replace, not an additional positive recital of Damage/Destroy protection. Q117 asks the Destroy case and Q118 asks the conditional Damage case separately.

questions.question: Two Spirits with one Presence each in the same land use Entwined Power. For what purposes may they treat it as a Sacred Site? Does this allow counting the other’s Presence in a Power’s text, and does River’s Wetland rule transfer to the other Spirit?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Two Spirits with one Presence each in the same land use Entwined Power. For what purposes may they treat it as a Sacred Site? Does this allow counting the other’s Presence in a Power’s text, and does River’s Wetland rule transfer to the other Spirit?
required_facts: Combined Presence under Entwined may be treated as a Sacred Site only for targeting Powers.
It is not a real shared Sacred Site for Fear or other effects.
It does not share Presence ownership or counts for Power text/your-land effects.
River's Wetland Sacred Site rule remains River's own and does not transfer to the other Spirit.

questions.question: In solo, what does Entwined Power grant from its normal gain wording and its Energy threshold? Can gifting another Spirit a Unique with a defined special effect such as Drown still use that definition?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In solo, what does Entwined Power grant from its normal gain wording and its Energy threshold? Can gifting another Spirit a Unique with a defined special effect such as Drown still use that definition?
required_facts: In solo Entwined's normal gain wording can give two Power Cards.
Its threshold can give 6 Energy.
A gifted card can still use a defined effect such as Drown.

key_context_not_required.fact: Each separate Major gain needs Forgetting; skip unavailable personal-track instructions.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The first part asks Entwined gain counts/Energy in solo, not Major selection, Forgetting or a missing-track example. The second asks whether a gifted defined effect such as Drown remains usable.

key_context_not_required.fact: Under the Drown definition, Drowned Invaders are destroyed and placed on Ocean's panel.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The gifted-card clause asks whether the defined special effect remains usable. It does not request re-explaining the Drown definition or token destination.

questions.question: Can Mantle of Dread choose one of target Spirit’s lands with only an Explorer even when another land has Explorer and Town? Can Tidal Boon Push Dahan from a land without a Town, and does its if-Dahan-are-pushed clause apply to later unrelated Pushes?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Can Mantle of Dread choose one of target Spirit’s lands with only an Explorer even when another land has Explorer and Town? Can Tidal Boon Push Dahan from a land without a Town, and does its if-Dahan-are-pushed clause apply to later unrelated Pushes?
required_facts: Mantle may select a target Spirit land with only an Explorer even when a different land has both types; do as much as possible in the selected land.
Tidal Boon may Push Dahan from a land with no Town.
Tidal's if-Dahan-are-pushed clause applies only to that Power's Push, not later unrelated Pushes.

questions.question: Where is Fear from a Spirit-targeting Mantle of Dread generated for Dread Apparitions? Compare Fear from Harbingers of the Lightning.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Where is Fear from a Spirit-targeting Mantle of Dread generated for Dread Apparitions? Compare Fear from Harbingers of the Lightning.
required_facts: Mantle's Spirit-targeted Fear is not generated in a particular land, so it adds no Defend through Dread Apparitions.
Harbingers generates its conditional Fear in its target land, not the pushed-to land.

questions.question: When does Lightning use Swiftness of Lightning, how many Powers can it make Fast, do Innates count, and what if Air is gained or lost during the turn?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When does Lightning use Swiftness of Lightning, how many Powers can it make Fast, do Innates count, and what if Air is gained or lost during the turn?
required_facts: Use Swiftness of Lightning during Fast.
It can make one Power Fast per current Air Element; Innates count.
Each use checks current Air against prior uses.
Gaining/losing Air changes remaining allowance without resetting uses or preserving an earlier peak.

questions.question: River has one disk in Wetland, making it a Sacred Site via River’s Domain. Does this count as two Presence for effects? When moving or affecting a Sacred Site, can River use one or two actual Presence?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: River has one disk in Wetland, making it a Sacred Site via River’s Domain. Does this count as two Presence for effects? When moving or affecting a Sacred Site, can River use one or two actual Presence?
required_facts: River's one Wetland disk still counts as one actual Presence despite forming a Sacred Site.
For moving/affecting a Sacred Site River may choose one or two actual Presence as applicable and available.

questions.question: Shadows pays Shadows of the Dahan to use a Sacred-Site-origin Power on a Dahan land far away. What requirements remain, when is the surcharge paid, and must it be paid again for a Repeat?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Shadows pays Shadows of the Dahan to use a Sacred-Site-origin Power on a Dahan land far away. What requirements remain, when is the surcharge paid, and must it be paid again for a Repeat?
required_facts: Shadows still needs an actual Sacred Site origin and all nonnumeric origin/target restrictions.
Pay 1 Energy when using/resolving the Power, not when playing its card.
The Range-ignore change carries to an ordinary Repeat and does not require another surcharge.

key_context_not_required.fact: Explicit Repeat location overrides normal targeting.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: No specified-location Repeat is given; Q43 directly asks that separate branch.

questions.question: For Shadows’ Darkness Swallows the Unwary, may a player use only the second level to destroy Explorers while declining a possible first-level Gather when both levels use the same required Elements?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For Shadows’ Darkness Swallows the Unwary, may a player use only the second level to destroy Explorers while declining a possible first-level Gather when both levels use the same required Elements?
required_facts: It cannot omit an available first-level Gather and then use the second destruction level.
Fewer Elements must be assumed consistently for the whole Power; no set enabling the second level avoids the first.
Resolve the possible Gather before destroying.

questions.question: Is Rampant Green’s Choke the Land with Green mandatory in a printing missing may? Does Steady Regeneration check local land Blight or the Blight Card? Can Growth’s mandatory placement await the Power gained by another selected option?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Is Rampant Green’s Choke the Land with Green mandatory in a printing missing may? Does Steady Regeneration check local land Blight or the Blight Card? Can Growth’s mandatory placement await the Power gained by another selected option?
required_facts: Choke the Land with Green is optional even in a printing missing may.
Steady Regeneration checks the Healthy/Blighted state of the Blight Card, not local Blight.
Growth instructions can be ordered to gain a Power before deciding the mandatory placement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Explicit regeneration can use destroyed Presence.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The regeneration question asks which Healthy/Blighted state is checked, not which disks regeneration may use.

questions.question: Two Dahan Move (not Gather or Push) from one land to another. How many of Thunderspeaker’s Presence may accompany them? If they move into an Ocean made legal by Ocean’s rule, may Presence accompany them there?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Two Dahan Move (not Gather or Push) from one land to another. How many of Thunderspeaker’s Presence may accompany them? If they move into an Ocean made legal by Ocean’s rule, may Presence accompany them there?
required_facts: Ally of the Dahan can accompany generic Move as well as Gather/Push.
Up to one Presence per Dahan moved can accompany them, so up to two here.
Presence can accompany Dahan into an Ocean legally affected by the Power/Ocean rule.

questions.question: A Ravage kills a Dahan but adds no Blight because a Power prevents it. Does Sworn to Victory still destroy Thunderspeaker Presence, and before or after cascades and counterattack?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Ravage kills a Dahan but adds no Blight because a Power prevents it. Does Sworn to Victory still destroy Thunderspeaker Presence, and before or after cascades and counterattack?
required_facts: A Ravage killing Dahan still triggers Sworn to Victory even if no Blight was added.
For the one Dahan killed in this Ravage, destroy one of Thunderspeaker's Presence.
Resolve the whole single-land Ravage, including Blight/cascades and counterattack, before that Presence loss.

key_context_not_required.fact: Sworn to Victory selects the Presence to destroy within Range 1 of the Ravaged land.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks whether Sworn to Victory still triggers without Blight and whether its loss happens before or after the Ravage/cascades/counterattack. It never asks where the destroyed Presence may be chosen.

key_context_not_required.fact: For each Dahan destroyed by a Ravage, Sworn to Victory destroys one of Thunderspeaker's Presence as instructed.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The actual premise kills one Dahan. The general per-Dahan multiplier is background beyond this case.

questions.question: On a board with Ocean’s Presence only in a Coastal land, can a Power Push Invaders into that board’s Ocean to Drown? Must Ocean have Presence in the Ocean itself, and can Fear Cards or Invader actions ordinarily use it as a land?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: On a board with Ocean’s Presence only in a Coastal land, can a Power Push Invaders into that board’s Ocean to Drown? Must Ocean have Presence in the Ocean itself, and can Fear Cards or Invader actions ordinarily use it as a land?
required_facts: Any Ocean Presence on the board activates that board's Ocean for Powers/Blight; Presence in the Ocean itself is unnecessary.
A Power can Push Invaders into that active Ocean to Drown them.
It is not normally a land for Fear Cards or Invader actions.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ocean In Play Drowns moved humans after the originating movement action.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks whether the Push-to-Ocean is legal, where Ocean Presence must be, and which action types treat Ocean as land. It does not ask the trigger timing relative to completion of the movement Power.
